Most orders arrive in two to four working days. Orders placed before 2 pm on a working day leave our studio the same day. Delivery options Standard. Two to four working days in the European Union, four to six working days to the United Kingdom, Norway and Switzerland. Free on orders over €60, otherwise €6. Express. One to two working days in the European Union, two to three elsewhere. €12 on every order. You choose the option at checkout, and the delivery estimate is shown next to each one before you pay. Weekends and holidays We pack orders from Monday to Friday. Orders placed on a weekend or a public holiday in Italy leave us on the next working day.
